& as I may well be the only person with an advanced computer science degree¹ specifically related (albeit tangentially) to the question of whether or not #Perl is a compiled or interpreted #programming language, I give you permission to call Perl either.

I controversially believe that #Java — when run on a #JVM and not natively compiled — is actually interpreted. Obviously many people compile Java to native assembler these days, though.

¹ https://www.ebb.org/bkuhn/articles/thesis/
